description: The manifest declares contractVersions as an explicit JSON null — the field present, its value null. §4's default is keyed on absence, not on the value, so the default does not apply: manifestContractVersions wraps the null into a one-element array holding it, and declaredVersionsMatch refuses, because null is not a §3 major. This sits between the two neighbouring cases — the field absent, and the field a non-array scalar — and a binding that reaches the default by testing the value rather than the key answers ["1"] here, matches, and passes both of them.
